name: Husbando Rater
source:
This project is a comedy/parody/light hearted game centered around a world torn asunder by warring factions of fans, all claiming their own Rightful Husbando is the best. (If unfamiliar, the concept of fan armies is a bit like Beliebers, Swifties, etc., except this game has nothing to do with music.) You, the player, have been hired and tasked by Rater Inc to rate these Husbandos. How you rate them is entirely up to you; whether by appearance or by judgement of character or any other reason. Your only task is to rate the Husbandos. 

Features: 
-RATE THOSE HUSBANDOS!!
-4 Different Endings!
-Make those decisions!
-Spot those references!
-Each play through is slightly different!
-Short game! Less than 5-7min play time!

From: [url=http://chocomarimo.itch.io/husbando-rater]itch.io[/url]
translation:
这是一个喜剧、恶搞、轻松的游戏，世界被互相交战的粉丝派系撕裂；每个派系都声称自己支持的“老公”才是最棒的。（如果你不熟悉，这种粉丝军团有点像比伯粉、霉粉等，但本游戏与音乐无关。）玩家受Rater公司雇佣，负责给这些“老公”打分。你可以根据外貌、性格判断或其他任何理由评分。你唯一的任务，就是给“老公”打分。

游戏特色：
- 给那些“老公”评分！！
- 4种不同结局！
- 作出那些决定！
- 找出那些致敬梗！
- 每次游玩都会略有不同！
- 短篇游戏！游玩时间少于5至7分钟！

来源：[url=http://chocomarimo.itch.io/husbando-rater]itch.io[/url]
